newsitem.title: JAPAN: Quick budget passage needed for Japan economy - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Quick budget passage needed for Japan economy - MITI.

text.p: Quick passage of an extra budget for the current fiscal year and the full budget for the 1997/98 year is necessary for Japan's economic recovery, Trade Minister Shinji Sato told reporters on Friday.
Asked whether extra measures were needed to help the economy, Sato said that the economy had been gradually recovering since last year and the recovery was gathering strength.
"If this becomes more concrete, the future will become brighter," he said.
Sato said that while he was interested in the state of the stock market, price movements would depend on the outlook for the economy. He said he was more interested in foreign exchange movements.
"We've gone from a high yen towards a weaker yen, we have both exports and imports. I'd like to keep an eye on the situation," he said.
